QuestInfo.name: The Lost Seal Stone of Ellin Forest
QuestInfo.0: It turns out that the Seal Stone of Ellin Forest was taken by #o9300353# of the Black Wings. How did this happen? You'd better go talk to #b#p2131000##k in the #bCamp Conference Room#k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2131000# reveals that she has a letter that contains information about another Seal Stone and promises to hand it to you. But you can't take the letter for some reason. Just when you think all hope is lost, #p2131000# tells you that she's actually a fairy who can live for centuries, and that she will carry the letter to your time. What you need to do now is leave Ellin Forest and #bmeet #p2131000# back in your own time#k. You wonder where you should meet. You'd better ask #b#p1002104##k.
QuestInfo.2: You asked #p1002104# whether he knows anyone named #p2131000#. It turned out that #p1002104# is one of the most well-known people in all of Victoria Island. You should head to #m100000201# in #m100000000# to meet Athena Pierce at the Bowman Instructional School.

1.0: Oh, you're back! Did you visit the past? Did you meet someone you know? What, are you really asking if I know #p2131000#?
1.1: Of course I know her! She's one of the most famous people in Victoria Island. She's the protector of #m100000000# and master of all Bowmen. Honestly, who HASN'T heard of #p2131000##k of #b#m100000000# #m100000201#? If you're planning on seeing #p2131000#, you should hurry over to the Bowman Instructional School.\r\n\r\n#b(When you accept, you will move to Henesys.)

npc.0: #bPlease find me in your time period#k! I'll be waiting for you even then, waiting to fulfill the promise we made here today...
